div.div: Boxes are TESPy nodes (power_plant.nodes); arrows are power_plant.edges. Single fluid loop (H2O, common.fluid_name) throughout -- separator splits it into a liquid branch (→brine_pump) and a vapor branch (→turbine→condenser→condensate_pump), remerged at reinjection_mixer.
